generate_kid.description: Used to populate the kid field of the JWK with the a key ID non-reversibly from the public key (only with public keys in PEM format). See https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0f140bf1eeaf63c155f5eba1db8db9b5d52d5467/pkg/serviceaccount/jwt.go#L98

jwks.description: The calculated JSON Web Key Sets.

key.description: Requires either a pem encoded or base64 der encoded public or private key.

kid.description: Used to populate the kid field of the JWK.

block.description: Calculates a JSON Web Key Set from a given public or private key.
